# Chapter 9: The Year of Firsts

The first night after Nancy died, Bob sat alone in the living room where they had absorbed the diagnosis years before. He tried to feel her presence — to sense that she was somehow still there, watching over them. But there was nothing. Just emptiness. The weight of absence that was only beginning to make itself known.
